caption:
Jensen Huang ran Nvidia for 33 years. Four days after a staff memo admitting an affair, he resigned. The affair itself was not the main issue: national-security questions, a reported relationship with an executive who reported to him, and a company built around one man. Nvidia reports Tuesday, its first results without him.
